patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro do pão e do trabalho

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Seek first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Buscai primeiro o Reino de Deus e a sua justiça.

meta.face: A man of about fifty with a ROUND face and soft, full cheeks — a short, straight nose with a rounded tip, large, beautiful dark-brown eyes under gently arched dark brows, low, soft cheekbones, a small, sweet, full-lipped mouth and a rounded chin; short dark-brown hair thinning at the crown, a short, close, rounded dark beard threaded with grey, and his gaze lowered to the Child with a tender smile.
meta.basis: No portrait from life survives; Erasmo Danese's description (medium height, round face, beautiful eyes, a mouth full of sweetness) gives the face, and the standard iconography, from his letter about Christmas 1517 at Santa Maria Maggiore, gives the Child touching his beard.
